objective: Reconstruct the complete described DuTraveller multiplayer game with preserved legacy contracts and configurable gameplay data
overall_status: In progress. The seven phases are not all complete; statuses and remaining gates below are authoritative.
completion_rule: A phase is complete only when native code, required Blueprint/UI wiring, data/assets and its acceptance checks pass. A build alone is not completion.

phases.name: Verify multiplayer foundation
scope: Server-owned GAS attributes and permanent point spending
Equipment bonuses that apply and remove once
Item -> Equipment -> Gear and separate consumable branches
phases.gate: Native regression tests plus a host/remote-client check of ownership, state convergence and UI notifications

phases.name: Restore playable inventory and economy
scope: Food and potions with server-side effects
phases.gate: Two players can acquire, equip, use, trade with a vendor, craft and drop/recover items without duplication or loss

phases.name: Restore hybrid skills and combat
scope: Configurable skills, costs, cooldowns and requirements
Animations, weapons, VFX and HUD integration
phases.gate: A remote player learns skills from different paths, equips them and uses them with matching costs, effects, cooldowns and presentation

phases.name: Restore parties and quests
scope: Personal, party, guild, class and area quest categories
Recover and integrate location-based quest spawners, random quests and quest groups
Restore server-owned random reward pools and stable reward claims
phases.gate: Multi-client scenarios verify private/shared progress, membership changes, repeated requests and reward eligibility

phases.name: Build guild settlement economy
scope: Building upgrades, guild technology and reputation
phases.gate: Guild members see consistent settlement state and concurrent actions preserve resources, currency and permissions

phases.name: Recover world and presentation
scope: Identify the main-world package and guild session travel
Recover missing skeletons or verify compatible original rigs
Validate animation, navigation, encounters and interactions
Recover and integrate random world spawners and bounded spawn areas, with population limits and quest-instance links
phases.gate: The intended worlds and representative player/AI/equipment combinations pass visual and gameplay checks

phases.name: Persist and package multiplayer game
scope: Save/load of points, skills, hotbars, items, equipment and quest reward claims
Persist selected random quests/rewards and supported spawn lifecycle state without duplicate spawns or rerolls
phases.gate: Packaged clients retain correct state across supported save, travel and reconnect flows without duplicate bonuses or rewards

working_rules: Preserve checkpoints before binary asset changes
Use the correct player, AI and guild hierarchy rather than inferring roles from prefixes
Keep unknown balance and permissions configurable and label reconstruction defaults
Do not fabricate rigs or report class shells as working features
Test narrow coherent changes before full-project sweeps
Record failed hypotheses and change approach after two unsuccessful attempts
Recover original data/assets alongside implementation without blocking independent source work
guild_design_clarification: The user confirmed the guild settlement was still in progress and needs a new system designed and implemented. Treat screenshots as prototype guidance and implement configurable rules rather than waiting for a complete original guild codebase.
current_limitations: Original skill/effect/item definitions and exact economy formulas are incomplete
The exact main-world map package remains unidentified; guild settlement behavior is authorized new design

The focused vendor/crafting transaction and party-authority regressions pass. The production two-client foundation has 28 distinct checks passing with zero Blueprint runtime errors, and all selected UI, currency and pickup Blueprints compile up to date. Full two-client commerce playthroughs, shared-party quests, guild settlement gameplay, complete combat presentation, persistence and packaged/dedicated-server testing remain incomplete.

foundation_verification.host_client_checks: 28 distinct checks passed, 0 failed, with zero Blueprint runtime errors
foundation_verification.scope: Two PIE worlds in one editor process using the production RPGPlayerController, widgets and BP_MasterPickupItem; verifies owner-only HUD/inventory creation, overlay-controller assignment, inventory open/close, owner privacy, replicated equipment/consumables/attributes, remote drop and collection, attribute-controller notifications and a populated local hover tooltip. It does not establish complete vendor/crafting UI, visuals, dedicated-server or packaged behavior.

spawn_and_random_quest_scope: User confirms these systems existed in the GitHub project. Recovery evidence, unverified original rules and multiplayer acceptance checks are recorded in Docs/SpawnAndRandomQuestContract.json. Quest groups are not assumed to mean player parties.

implemented_spawn_quest_increment.native: Eight native regressions pass, including physics-backed ground/collision checks
implemented_spawn_quest_increment.multiplayer: Forty-four listen-server/remote-client checks pass, including actor context replication and exact stable rewards
implemented_spawn_quest_increment.remaining: Production content placement, existing quest widget binding, party/guild ownership and full save orchestration remain separate phase gates

implemented_combat_skill_increment.hierarchy: RPGActionComponent is the master replicated runtime for attacks, spells, utility actions and passives; child action objects are not individually replicated
implemented_combat_skill_increment.native: Nine restoration regressions pass including CombatAndHybridSkills
implemented_combat_skill_increment.remaining: Production ability data, input/HUD, montage/VFX/projectiles, AI activation and multiplayer/package validation remain before phase completion

implemented_ui_replication_increment.model: Widgets and widget-controller UObjects are owning-client presentation objects; replicated gameplay state remains in the authoritative PlayerState/components and the master ActionComponent.
implemented_ui_replication_increment.controllers: Overlay, attribute and spell controller native parents now bind replicated state and retain their Blueprint child identities.
implemented_ui_replication_increment.audit: All 28 selected controller, HUD, attribute, spell, globe, inventory, crafting, tooltip, currency, pickup and quest assets compile BS_UP_TO_DATE.
implemented_ui_replication_increment.inventory_hover: The shared RPG_ItemWidget and RPG_ItemToolTip parents create, attach and refresh detailed item hover presentation. Empty slots and missing currency balances use safe local presentation objects, and Bronze/Gold use the Currency item branch. A real owning remote client passed the replicated item/quantity tooltip check with zero Blueprint runtime errors.
implemented_ui_replication_increment.production_lifecycle: The owning production RPGPlayerController creates WBP_HUD, assigns the overlay controller, injects the pawn inventory into WBP_PlayerInventory and toggles it locally with the configured inventory input.
implemented_ui_replication_increment.remaining: Complete visible vendor/crafting/equipment interaction playthroughs, all production skill/quest/party notifications and packaged multiplayer UI validation.

implemented_pickup_drop_increment.hierarchy: RPGPickupItem is the native replicated parent; BP_MasterPickupItem is the configured production factory and BP_Pickup remains its child.
implemented_pickup_drop_increment.authority: Drop and collection requests route to the server. The server validates ownership, quantity, equipped state and collection distance.
implemented_pickup_drop_increment.atomicity: The world pickup is created and initialized before inventory consumption. A failed spawn preserves the stack; partial collection leaves the remainder in the pickup.
implemented_pickup_drop_increment.presentation: Item class and quantity replicate publicly while private inventory subobjects remain owner-only. Local presentation objects support retained interaction widgets without becoming spendable inventory.
implemented_pickup_drop_increment.verification: InventoryValidation passed; the two-client production run passed 28 distinct checks with zero Blueprint runtime errors.

implemented_commerce_increment.authority: Vendor purchases and crafting exchanges commit costs, output and finite stock atomically on the server.
implemented_commerce_increment.replication: Vendor offers replicate publicly; recipe subobjects and recipe definitions replicate owner-only.
implemented_commerce_increment.ui: WBP_CraftingMenu and WBP_NPCVendorShop use native owning-client bridge parents, refresh from replicated gameplay state and route actions through server RPCs. BP_MasterVendor is the production vendor parent.
implemented_commerce_increment.verification: CraftingAndCurrencyTransactions passes with the known GameplayCue-path warning only; the retained commerce widgets compile up to date.
implemented_commerce_increment.remaining: A production two-client visible buy/craft playthrough and authored recipes/offers remain required.

implemented_party_increment.authority: Party invitations, acceptance, decline, leave, leader-only invitation and leader transfer run on the server.
implemented_party_increment.replication: Every member receives the same stable party ID, leader and roster; pending invitations are owner-only.
implemented_party_increment.verification: PartyAuthority passes with the known GameplayCue-path warning only.
implemented_party_increment.remaining: Shared quest acceptance/progress/rewards, party UI and two-client PIE validation remain required.
